obligations.name: SquareZeroRankOne.scalar_product
obligations.statement: For any commutative ring R, x*x=0 implies (1-x*c)*(1+x*c)=1.

obligations.name: SquareZeroRankOne.matrix_right_product
obligations.statement: For finite square matrices over a commutative ring, x*x=0 and A*G=1 imply (A-x•U)*(G+x•(G*U*G))=1 for every U.

obligations.name: SquareZeroRankOne.matrix_left_product
obligations.statement: For finite square matrices over a commutative ring, x*x=0 and G*A=1 imply (G+x•(G*U*G))*(A-x•U)=1 for every U.

obligations.name: SquareZeroRankOne.rank_one_two_sided
obligations.statement: Specialize the two matrix product equalities to U=vecMulVec u v, retaining both A*G=G*A=1 assumptions.

obligations.name: SquareZeroRankOne.propagate_left_factor
obligations.statement: B*(G+x•(G*U*G))=B*G+x•((B*G)*U*G), as an explicit scalar-linear matrix identity.

scope: Explicit square-zero update identities; no root polynomial-extraction assumption.
